Colossus plays, world resonates. 👁️🌩️
Season 5 of the free-to-play strange worlds survival game, Once Human, drops on November 18 (PT). 

Look up to the sky. A gargantuan pipe-organ leviathan now commands the horizon of Once Human. It is always watching, always listening, and its mood dictates the apocalypse below.
Welcome to Season 5: Dissonant Resonance. The free-to-play strange wilderness has been warped into an acoustic nightmare driven by Joy, Anger, Sorrow, and Fear. Face the music directly as you and your squad step through the rift to confront the living-machine Colossus in an epic, reality-bending showdown.
